formula: direct origination AUM + asset-backed finance AUM + opportunistic credit AUM + multi-credit AUM
derived_claim: Apollo disclosed at least 675.7B USD across four named credit-strategy AUM lanes in FY2025.
claim_boundary: This is Apollo credit-strategy AUM scale, not a borrower-use-of-proceeds table and not proof of bank displacement.

formula: direct origination AUM / selected Apollo credit-strategy AUM
derived_claim: Direct origination is the largest disclosed Apollo credit-strategy lane in this selected FY2025 credit set.
claim_boundary: The denominator is the selected named credit-strategy lanes extracted here, not total Apollo AUM or total credit AUM.

formula: asset-backed finance AUM / selected Apollo credit-strategy AUM
derived_claim: Asset-backed finance is nearly as large as direct origination in the selected Apollo FY2025 credit set.
claim_boundary: This does not reveal collateral mix or credit quality inside ABF.

formula: Athene Accounts fee-generating AUM / Athene Accounts AUM
derived_claim: Almost all extracted Athene-related account AUM was fee-generating for Apollo at FY2025 year-end.
claim_boundary: This proves monetizable managed-account scale, not the exact spread or fee rate earned on each asset class.

formula: Athene Accounts AUM / Apollo total AUM
derived_claim: Athene-related accounts represented about 41.8% of Apollo's FY2025 total AUM.
claim_boundary: This uses Apollo's FY2025 total AUM from the source extraction notes; it does not mean all Athene-related AUM is private credit.

formula: net invested assets / gross invested assets
derived_claim: Athene net invested assets were about 75.6% of gross invested assets at FY2025 year-end after noncontrolling-interest and other adjustments.
claim_boundary: This is an invested-asset reconciliation ratio, not a risk-quality measure by itself.

formula: floating-rate liabilities / floating-rate investments
derived_claim: Athene's floating-rate liabilities offset about 92.8% of floating-rate investments at FY2025 year-end.
claim_boundary: This supports rate-exposure management, not credit-loss safety.

formula: net floating-rate assets / net invested assets
derived_claim: Athene's net floating-rate asset exposure was about 1.2% of net invested assets after liability offset.
claim_boundary: This does not measure duration, convexity, hedges, or surrender behavior under stress.

formula: capital available to deploy / net invested assets
derived_claim: Athene's disclosed capital available to deploy was about 2.9% of FY2025 net invested assets.
claim_boundary: This is deployable capital capacity, not current private-credit exposure.

formula: invested insurance assets * private-credit allocation
derived_claim: Brookfield's disclosed 33% private-credit allocation implies about 55.2B USD of private-credit exposure on Q2 2026 invested insurance assets.
claim_boundary: This is a derived allocation estimate using disclosed percent and invested assets; it still needs portfolio holdings and credit-quality schedules.

formula: invested insurance assets * public-credit allocation
derived_claim: Brookfield's disclosed 49% public-credit allocation implies about 82.0B USD of public-credit exposure on Q2 2026 invested insurance assets.
claim_boundary: This does not separate government corporate structured or other public-credit types.

formula: invested insurance assets * private-funds allocation
derived_claim: Brookfield's disclosed 5% private-funds allocation implies about 8.4B USD of private-fund exposure on Q2 2026 invested insurance assets.
claim_boundary: This does not identify underlying fund strategies or related-party exposure.

formula: private credit allocation + private funds allocation
derived_claim: Brookfield's private credit plus private funds allocation equals 38% of the disclosed insurance investment portfolio mix.
claim_boundary: This is a private-assets proxy, not a statutory Schedule BA number.

formula: invested insurance assets * (private credit + private funds allocation)
derived_claim: Brookfield's private-credit plus private-funds allocation implies about 63.6B USD of private-asset exposure on Q2 2026 invested insurance assets.
claim_boundary: This still needs borrower/asset-pool holdings and valuation-level evidence.

formula: private credit implied dollars / total insurance assets
derived_claim: Brookfield's implied private-credit exposure equals about 29.0% of total insurance assets.
claim_boundary: This combines allocation and balance-sheet measures and should be treated as directional until reconciled to statutory schedules.

formula: LTM distributable earnings / average invested insurance assets
derived_claim: Brookfield Wealth Solutions generated LTM distributable earnings equal to about 1.1% of average invested insurance assets.
claim_boundary: This is not the same as investment yield or spread; Brookfield separately discloses net yield and cost of funds.

formula: Global Atlantic credit AUM / Global Atlantic AUM
derived_claim: About 74.5% of Global Atlantic AUM was identified as credit AUM in the extracted Q2 2026 KKR release metrics.
claim_boundary: This does not separate public credit from private credit or show borrower destinations.

formula: Ivy and sponsored reinsurance vehicles AUM / Global Atlantic AUM
derived_claim: Ivy and sponsored reinsurance vehicle AUM equaled about 28.2% of Global Atlantic AUM.
claim_boundary: This shows reinsurance-vehicle scale but not the asset mix inside those vehicles.

formula: Global Atlantic AUM / KKR total AUM
derived_claim: Global Atlantic AUM equaled about 27.6% of KKR total AUM in Q2 2026.
claim_boundary: This is platform-scale context and should not be read as all KKR insurance AUM being private credit.

formula: quarterly capital invested / quarterly new capital raised
derived_claim: KKR invested about 70.6 cents for every dollar of new capital raised in Q2 2026.
claim_boundary: This is a same-quarter activity ratio, not proof that the same dollars raised were invested in the same quarter.

formula: LTM capital invested / LTM new capital raised
derived_claim: KKR's LTM capital invested equaled about 78.2% of LTM new capital raised.
claim_boundary: This indicates strong deployment relative to fundraising but not strategy-level destination by itself.

formula: Credit & Insurance AUM / total Blackstone AUM
derived_claim: Blackstone Credit & Insurance represented about 34.9% of Blackstone total AUM in Q2 2026.
claim_boundary: This is segment scale, not evidence of owned insurance liabilities.

formula: Credit & Insurance fee-earning AUM / Credit & Insurance AUM
derived_claim: About 67.8% of Blackstone Credit & Insurance AUM was fee-earning AUM.
claim_boundary: This does not measure fee rate, realization earnings, or credit risk.

formula: global direct-lending inflows / Credit & Insurance quarterly inflows
derived_claim: Direct lending accounted for about 42.9% of Blackstone Credit & Insurance Q2 2026 inflows.
claim_boundary: This is inflow mix, not asset balance or borrower-level destination.

formula: infrastructure and asset-based credit inflows / Credit & Insurance quarterly inflows
derived_claim: Infrastructure and asset-based credit strategies accounted for about 31.9% of Blackstone Credit & Insurance Q2 2026 inflows.
claim_boundary: This does not reveal the underlying collateral pools or insurers' final asset allocation.

formula: insurance SMA inflows / infrastructure and asset-based credit inflows
derived_claim: Insurance SMA inflows represented about 75.8% of Blackstone's infrastructure and asset-based credit strategy inflows cited in the Q2 2026 extraction.
claim_boundary: This supports insurer-client importance in this flow bucket but not Blackstone-owned insurance liabilities.

formula: insurance SMA inflows / Credit & Insurance quarterly inflows
derived_claim: Insurance SMA inflows represented about 24.2% of Blackstone Credit & Insurance quarterly inflows.
claim_boundary: This is one-quarter flow evidence and should not be annualized without more periods.

formula: Credit & Insurance LTM capital deployed / Credit & Insurance LTM inflows
derived_claim: Blackstone Credit & Insurance LTM capital deployed equaled about 45.7% of LTM inflows.
claim_boundary: This is a deployment-to-inflow activity ratio, not proof that the same capital was deployed or that undeployed capital has no destination.

formula: insurance investments / insurance policy liabilities
derived_claim: Global Atlantic insurance investments equaled about 92.1% of insurance policy liabilities at Q2 2026.
claim_boundary: This is a GAAP balance-sheet ratio, not a statutory capital adequacy ratio.

formula: AFS fixed maturity securities / insurance investments
derived_claim: AFS fixed maturity securities represented about 46.5% of Global Atlantic insurance investments.
claim_boundary: This does not split investment grade from below investment grade or public from private credit.

formula: mortgage and other loan receivables net / insurance investments
derived_claim: Mortgage and other loan receivables represented about 25.8% of Global Atlantic insurance investments.
claim_boundary: This loan bucket includes commercial mortgage residential mortgage consumer and other loans; it is not all corporate private credit.

formula: real assets / insurance investments
derived_claim: Real assets represented about 8.1% of Global Atlantic insurance investments.
claim_boundary: This does not identify underlying real-asset sectors or valuation risk.

formula: mortgage and other loan allowance for credit losses / gross mortgage and other loan receivables
derived_claim: The mortgage-and-other-loan allowance equaled about 1.36% of gross mortgage and other loan receivables.
claim_boundary: This is an allowance ratio, not a forward default forecast.

formula: mortgage loans 90 days or foreclosure / total mortgage loans gross
derived_claim: Mortgage loans 90 days or more past due or in foreclosure were about 0.66% of total mortgage loans by property type.
claim_boundary: This uses the disclosed non-income-producing amount and total mortgage-loan property-type denominator; it does not include consumer loans.

formula: commercial mortgage loans LTV over 90% / commercial mortgage loans gross
derived_claim: Commercial mortgage loans with LTV over 90% were about 2.1% of commercial mortgage loans.
claim_boundary: This only covers the CML LTV table, not residential mortgage or consumer loan risk.

formula: FHLB funding-agreement pledged assets / insurance investments
derived_claim: FHLB funding-agreement pledged assets equaled about 4.9% of Global Atlantic insurance investments.
claim_boundary: This shows bank-adjacent funding interaction, not bank displacement.

formula: total investments / total assets
derived_claim: Brookfield Wealth Solutions total investments represented about 73.1% of total assets at FY2025 year-end.
claim_boundary: This is audited annual balance-sheet mix, not a private-credit allocation; the private-credit percent comes from the Q2 2026 supplement.

formula: policyholders account balances / total assets
derived_claim: Policyholder account balances represented about 59.2% of total assets at FY2025 year-end.
claim_boundary: This is a liability-base ratio, not proof that a specific liability funded a specific loan.

formula: total liabilities / total assets
derived_claim: Total liabilities represented about 88.6% of Brookfield Wealth Solutions total assets at FY2025 year-end.
claim_boundary: This is GAAP/IFRS balance-sheet leverage context, not a regulatory capital adequacy ratio.

formula: total equity / total assets
derived_claim: Total equity represented about 11.4% of total assets at FY2025 year-end.
claim_boundary: This is an accounting ratio, not a statutory solvency measure.

formula: total unfunded investment commitments / total investments
derived_claim: Unfunded investment commitments equaled about 10.7% of FY2025 total investments, adding a forward-deployment lens to the insurance balance sheet.
claim_boundary: Commitments are not funded assets yet and may fund across mortgage loans private loans funds real estate and other invested assets.

formula: reinsurance recoverables and deposit assets / total assets
derived_claim: Reinsurance recoverables and deposit assets represented about 7.7% of total assets at FY2025 year-end.
claim_boundary: This is exposure/context for reinsurance complexity, not a counterparty-risk conclusion.

formula: corporate borrowings plus non-recourse borrowings / total assets
derived_claim: Corporate and non-recourse borrowings together represented about 3.5% of FY2025 total assets.
claim_boundary: This omits policyholder liabilities and reinsurance liabilities, so it is not a full liability ratio.

formula: credit group AUM / total AUM
derived_claim: Ares Credit Group represented about 65.6% of total Ares AUM at Q2 2026.
claim_boundary: This is credit-platform scale, not proof that all credit AUM is private credit or direct lending.

formula: credit group FPAUM / total FPAUM
derived_claim: Ares Credit Group represented about 64.9% of fee-paying AUM at Q2 2026.
claim_boundary: This measures fee-paying credit scale, not borrower-level use of proceeds.

formula: credit group FPAUM / credit group AUM
derived_claim: About 60.4% of Ares Credit Group AUM was fee-paying at Q2 2026.
claim_boundary: The rest includes non-fee-paying and not-yet-fee-paying AUM; it does not mean unused cash.

formula: U.S. direct lending AUM + European direct lending AUM
derived_claim: Ares disclosed about 285.7B USD of U.S. and European direct lending AUM at Q2 2026.
claim_boundary: This excludes APAC credit and other credit strategies and does not identify individual borrowers.

formula: U.S. and European direct lending AUM / credit group AUM
derived_claim: U.S. and European direct lending represented about 64.9% of Ares Credit Group AUM.
claim_boundary: This is a strategy mix ratio, not a bank-displacement ratio.

formula: U.S. and European direct lending AUM / total AUM
derived_claim: U.S. and European direct lending represented about 42.6% of total Ares AUM.
claim_boundary: This does not include all direct lending geographies and does not show borrower source-of-funds.

formula: credit Q2 new commitments / total Q2 new commitments
derived_claim: Credit represented about 65.0% of Ares Q2 2026 new AUM commitments.
claim_boundary: This combines par/equity and debt commitments and should not be read as funded deployment.

formula: credit FPAUM deployment/increase in leverage / total FPAUM deployment/increase in leverage
derived_claim: Credit represented about 70.2% of Ares Q2 2026 FPAUM deployment and increase in leverage.
claim_boundary: This measures fee-paying rollforward activity, not direct borrower originations.

formula: AUM not yet paying fees available for future deployment / total AUM
derived_claim: Ares disclosed future-deployment AUM not yet paying fees equal to about 13.8% of total AUM.
claim_boundary: This is future deployment runway, not already invested capital.
